nodes.description: IERC1155 NFT contract address stored in state; target of external calls.
uint256 price per NFT (0.25 ether) used to compute required msg.value.
uint256 token id (46) of the ERC1155 asset being sold.
Payable address receiving the sale proceeds via transfer.
Sale start timestamp compared against block.timestamp.
Payable public function: checks caller/timestamp/amount/value, transfers NFT out, then forwards ETH to multisig.
Public view returning the contract's ERC1155 balance for token id via external call.
ERC1155 receiver hook returning the magic selector; potential reentrancy entry point.
Deploys contract, wiring multisig, start, nft address and id.
Caller-supplied address used as buyer/recipient and in identity check.
Origin address compared to msg.sender to block contract callers.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to gate the sale start.
Buyer-supplied quantity parameter of buy(uint256 amount).
multisig.transfer(address(this).balance) draining full contract balance after the external NFT call.
External ERC1155 safeTransferFrom to msg.sender, invoking receiver hooks before state settlement.
price.mul(amount) arithmetic used to validate msg.value.
External view call nft.balanceOf(address(this), id) powering supply().

edges.reason: buy reads msg.sender as buyer/recipient.
buy compares msg.sender against tx.origin to reject contracts.
Sale gated on block.timestamp >= start, a miner-influenceable dependency.
Untrusted amount parameter flows into buy logic.
amount is an operand of price.mul(amount).
state price is an operand of price.mul(amount).
buy requires msg.value == price.mul(amount).
buy performs the external ERC1155 transfer before settling ETH payment.
msg.sender is the _to argument of safeTransferFrom.
state id is the token id argument of safeTransferFrom.
state nft is the external contract targeted by safeTransferFrom.
safeTransferFrom invokes receiver hooks that can re-enter buy before balance transfer.
onERC1155Received hook is the reentry surface reachable from buy.
buy forwards the whole contract balance after the external NFT transfer.
state multisig is the destination of the ETH transfer.
supply() is implemented by the external balanceOf call.
state nft is the contract queried by balanceOf.
state id is the token id queried by balanceOf.
constructor sets multisig from its argument.
constructor sets start from its argument.
constructor hardcodes the nft address.
constructor hardcodes the token id.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter amount is used only inside buy and should be folded into the buy function node as its untrusted quantity input.
